get_active_weight_column: get the active weight column name from a balance Sample object
drop_history_columns: drop balance adjustment history columns like weight_pre_adjust and weight_adjusted_N from a DataFrame
drop_nan_weight_rows: drop rows with NaN weights from a DataFrame before forwarding to a downstream adapter
validate_nonzero_weights: validate that a weight column has at least one positive entry and no negative entries
attach_balance_provenance: attach a balance Sample as provenance metadata to a downstream result object
